fr_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI voudrait éviter que l'on préjugeât, par cette dernière phrase, de la question de savoir si la Cour pourra, à la demande éventuelle des parties, statuer comme tribunal arbitral en s'écartant de l'application pure et simple des règles du droit international. L'appel à la conscience et à l'esprit de justice est, à son avis, suffisant.
en_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI thought that, by the inclusion of the last sentence, the question as to whether the Court could, if so requested by the parties, pronounce judgment as a tribunal of arbitration without confining itself to the strict application of rules of international law, would be prejudiced. He wished to avoid this. In his opinion, it would suffice to appeal to the conscience and to the sense of justice of the judges.
